Episodes.Title: Episode #1.1
Episodes.Actors: David Mitchell, Anna Maxwell Martin, Dipo Ola
Episodes.Plot: Puzzle setter John 'Ludwig' Taylor's life is upended when his identical twin, DCI James Taylor, disappears. John reluctantly assumes his identity in order to track him down.

Episodes.Title: Episode #1.2
Episodes.Actors: David Mitchell, Anna Maxwell Martin, Dipo Ola
Episodes.Plot: On a mission to crack the code in his twin's notebook, John returns to the police station. A frustrated Lucy takes matters into her own hands and plays detective herself.

Episodes.Title: Episode #1.3
Episodes.Actors: David Mitchell, Anna Maxwell Martin, Dipo Ola
Episodes.Plot: A new case takes Ludwig on a walking tour of Cambridge, where he's faced with an impossible question. Meanwhile, Lucy goes undercover and makes a grim discovery of her own.

Episodes.Title: Episode #1.4
Episodes.Actors: David Mitchell, Anna Maxwell Martin, Dipo Ola
Episodes.Plot: A body falls from the fourth storey of a construction site. Was it just a terrible accident, or a perfectly executed murder? When things don't add up, John questions his abilities.

Episodes.Title: Episode #1.5
Episodes.Actors: Suzanne Ahmet, Sophie Allen, Dorothy Atkinson
Episodes.Plot: John and the gang go back to school to investigate the suspicious death of a headmaster. Lucy sneaks off on a covert mission, and a shocking revelation leaves John reeling.

Episodes.Title: Episode #1.6
Episodes.Actors: Raychel Addo, Dorothy Atkinson, Josh Bolt
Episodes.Plot: A cryptic late night call from Holly sees Lucy lured into danger. Back at the station, all eyes are on John as the pressure ramps up. Will his cover finally be blown?
